findings.reason: Undo of a multi-seat retirement can restore a manager pointer to the wrong seat, which is incorrect behavior in the goal-named reparent-on-retire path (B6, B7).
A committed manager cycle makes /seat, who and show fail with an integrity error, which is incorrect behavior in the goal-named manager hierarchy (B5, B7, B9).
It only matters with an out-of-band corrupted graph, and apply fails safe without writing, so this is extra hardening and not a correctness defect in B6 reparenting.
Retiring a teamspace reverts its default_manager rewrite, so the store, the preview and the action record disagree, which is a misleading result in the goal-named reparent path (B6).
A closed node-manager tab can be recorded as 'gone' instead of retired after a concurrent node-manager move, so the node-manager handling (B8, B11, B13) is not correct in that case.
A missing changelog entry is documentation hygiene, and the goal names no behavior that depends on it.
Committed test logs are repo hygiene outside every goal-named behavior; it is the only member of its cluster, so it needs no override.
